name: Migration planner: non-positive price and bad seat counts show an error, never a report
description: FR3 validation. Invalid input must replace the impact report with an alert; fixing the input must bring the report back.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, then click the 'Migration' link in the top navigation bar
Clear the 'Current monthly price (USD)' field and type 0
Assert an alert with text 'Prices must be positive amounts.' is visible and 'MRR change' is not shown
Set 'Current monthly price (USD)' back to 29.00, then replace the seats field with '1, 2.5'
Assert an alert with text 'Seat counts must be positive whole numbers.' is visible
